style: Theatrical avant-garde funk and microtonal chamber folk, pélog-informed non-equidistant pitch collection with microtonal pure interval friction. Angular speech-contour talking-drum pitch bends and zampoña panpipe hockets. Cellular-automaton binary onset rules competing with dual entrainment clocks. Plucked upright bass, bowed cello, grainy viola, violin scratch tone, agogô bells, and speaking leader with a delayed distorted echo group. Frantic theatrical carnival barker delivery with motion-driven tempo scaling. Pirate radio transmission artifacts, pattern-sequencer workflow, and thermal throttling. Dissonance tax mechanics, density decreasing monotonically, memory confidence dictating volume, body height driving pitch, and audience feedback initialization. High-velocity manic performance in hell, caffeine catastrophe attention, demon obligation jurisdiction, and sanctimonious moral certainty.

[Carnival Barker lead volume surges on memory-confidence peak]

Pay the dissonance tax or forfeit your bones!

[Signal degradation: pirate radio carrier frequency drifts off-band with white noise wash]
[Memory confidence drops: lead vocal fades into a near-inaudible whisper]
[Motion-driven accelerando hits physical limit; tempo freezes and instantly cuts to dead silence]

Approved. Filed. Damned. Good day.
